purpose: Exploratory public-source snapshots for possible result-conditioned prior-art cases; these are not a matched current-path evaluation and no model inference or paid tools were used.

retrieval_protocol.source: Europe PMC REST API v5, keyless public GET

retrieval_protocol.error_policy: Every request stores HTTP status or exception type/message; errors are not interpreted as empty result sets.
retrieval_protocol.raw_payload_policy: Only returned IDs, bibliographic metadata, request URLs/times, and source-evidence summaries are retained; no full abstracts copied.

limitations: These are exploratory curated-keyword Europe PMC searches, not the current validation path. That path sends each draft's first 200 characters to the configured PubMed fulltext MCP tool; the present search snapshots cannot serve as a matched current-path baseline.
The non-overlap labels are provisional, single-curator comparisons of indexed source abstracts; independent blinded domain adjudication is still required before acceptance.
Control labels mean distinct from the paired known-prior-art idea, not novel versus the literature.
A small fixture supports a bounded pilot comparison only; it cannot establish general novelty-search performance.
Search snapshots are time-dependent. Reproduction requires preserving these captured query URLs, request times, and returned IDs.

scope_correction.correction: This fixture contains direct Europe PMC REST API keyword-search snapshots. It does not use the configured pubmed_fulltext MCP tool or the validation query rule draft_hypothesis[:200], so its nonempty results are not evidence that the current validation path supplies result-conditioned seed papers.
scope_correction.disposition: Do not treat this REST fixture as the M11-NOV-01a current-path acceptance fixture.
